name: Apify
description: Run Apify Actors — scrapers and automations — and read what they produce.
long_description:
Apify's hosted server. It finds Actors in their store, runs one, and reads the dataset it produced, which is how a chat scrapes a site it has no API for.

Sign in with your browser, or paste an Apify API token. An Actor run costs Apify credits, so running one is confirmed every time.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Apify in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Runs code on Apify's platform against sites of your choosing, and spends your Apify credits doing it.

auth_alternate.instructions: Or paste an Apify API token instead of signing in.
